text:
incident-bot: Auto-pager -> @oncall (Priya K). Production alert: sudden spike in client-reported low-quality outputs and an uptick in user-reported hallucinations. Affected path: smart-routing /policy/cost-v2.

Priya K: I'm live. Quick summary of symptoms?

incident-bot: Metrics: quality_score drop ~35% (rolling 10m), user complaints up x6. Routing telemetry shows 70% of traffic moved to 'redwood-lite-q4' at 03:42 UTC. Expected baseline: 'redwood-standard-1'.

Liam S: I deployed cost-v2 last night which dynamically shifts weight based on recent latency and cost. It appears the comparator used 50th latency instead of 95th which favored the cheaper variant during a transient tail spike.

Ben T: Observed retries: requests failing valuation check on lite variant then reissued, but sticky session token TTL (ttl=600) forced repeat selection of lit e variant -> amplified bad responses.

Zoe M: Support is getting noise. I've put a high-priority msg in #support-ops and notified key tenants. Some reports include truncated summaries and incorrect factual claims.

Priya K: Immediate actions: 1) Pause auto-weight adjustments. 2) Force route stable traffic to blue pool (standard models). 3) Clear sticky keys for impacted session prefixes. Who can run these?

Liam S: Pausing now:
```
redwoodctl policy update --id cost-v2 --set auto_adjust=false --env prod
```
ops-bot: policy cost-v2 updated (auto_adjust=false)

Ben T: Forcing blue routing ramp:
```
redwoodctl routing set --selector name=smart-route --target redwood-standard-1 --weight 100 --env prod
```
ops-bot: routing change accepted; staged 2/3 nodes

Priya K: I will perform selective purge of sticky keys: `redis-cli -h route-cache keys "session:*:stick" | xargs -L100 redis-cli -h route-cache del` (scoped to session prefixes). Proceeding.

incident-bot: After changes (03:46 UTC) quality_score up 22% over 5m, complaint rate reduced. Some tenants still showing degraded outputs due to pinned mappings.

Liam S: Found ~12 tenants with explicit model pins in their tenant configs pointing to redwood-lite-q4. Issuing migration script now: `tenantctl migrate --tenants-file pinned-tenants.txt --to redwood-standard-1`

Ben T: Also discovered fallback loop logic: when a model returns low-quality flag, fallback triggered but policy recomputed and still chose lite model due to stale metrics window. We'll add a short-circuit to prefer non-fallback targets for 1 minute.

Zoe M: Logged affected customers: list uploaded to S3 `s3://incidents/2026-03-10/cost-route-affected.csv`. CS pinged and proactive outreach underway.

Priya K: Escalating to Eng Runtime for permanent fix (Ben) and Product for policy guardrails (Liam). Please add to incident board.

Ben T: Creating PR to change comparator to p95 and add quality-floor check: `if p95_latency < threshold && quality_score >= floor` before promoting. Will also remove sticky behavior from auto-promote path.

Liam S: Opening follow-ups: 1) Add unit/e2e tests simulating burst latencies, 2) enforce canary percentage cap for cost-driven promos, 3) docs update for policy semantics.

Priya K: Oncall handoff in 45m to Ben. Current state: mitigated but monitoring. Timer started: I-2026031003. Keep channel updated for any regressions.

ops-bot: incident notification: mitigation actions applied, monitoring mode.

Zoe M: Support note posted: short explainer, apology, list of affected operations, and ETA for RCA (48h).

incident-bot: Logs and traces saved -> `s3://redwood-incidents/I-2026031003/trace-snapshot-03-42.tar.gz`. Post-incident actions: RCA, customer follow-up, test additions, and policy default changes. :eyes:
